title: Reschedule Fee Owed on a Northgate Delivery & Installation Appointment
content:
The reschedule fee owed on a Northgate Delivery & Installation appointment is the service level's reschedule fee for each move that owes one. The fee is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Moves that owe a fee

The recorded moves that owe a fee are the appointment's reschedule count less the service level's free reschedules less the reschedule fee entries already standing on the appointment, never fewer than none.

1. Reschedule count — the number of moves recorded on the appointment.
2. Free reschedules — the service level's number of free moves.
3. Reschedule fee entries already standing — the reschedule fee entries in the appointment's fee history.
4. Moves owed — the count less the free reschedules less the entries standing; where that comes to less than zero, none.
5. Fee owed — the service level's reschedule fee multiplied by the moves owed, rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical level: reschedule fee $30.00, 2 free reschedules)

| Reschedule count | Fee entries standing | Moves owed | Fee owed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 3 | 0 | 1 | $30.00 |
| 4 | 0 | 2 | $60.00 |
| 4 | 1 | 1 | $30.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 0 | Nothing owed |
| 1 | 0 | None (the count is below the free reschedules) | Nothing owed |
